name: Animal Mints 1g Live Resin Disposable
description:
Lineage: Animal Cookies x SinMint Cookies

Type: Indica

Terpenes: Caryophyllene, Myrcene, Limonene

Effects: Relaxed, Sleepy, Appetite Stimulating

Aroma: Sweet Mint, Earthy, Pine

Prepare to be tamed by Animal Mints — a powerhouse indica born from the legendary Animal Cookies and SinMint Cookies. This strain delivers a wild fusion of sweet, minty goodness with earthy undertones, like a refreshing dessert with a hint of the forest. Its dense, crystal-coated buds pack a punch of tranquility, making it the perfect choice to melt away stress and sink into serenity.
